title: Qualify typed undefined Pearson outcomes and explicit paired missing-value boundaries
commitMessage: feat: qualify typed correlation boundaries and close quantiles phase

contribution.summary: Qualify typed undefined Pearson outcomes on constant and singleton pairs, explicit default-Reject/opt-in SkipPair policies, and exact-knot finite Type-7 boundaries. Observe a compiled independent RED, pass 31 new GREEN and 103 total statistics tests, validate rational/numeric regressions and local preview.4 packaging, then complete T2 and C02 while preserving M3-W02 as in-progress.
contribution.value: Expose machine-readable covariance/correlation status without inventing Pearson zero, preserve aligned nullable pair counts and finite budgets, avoid duplicate numerical engines, and document truthful consumer conventions.
debtChanges: MissingPairPolicy64 defaults to Reject; SkipPair removes the entire aligned pair when either value is null and never treats nonfinite data as missing.
With exactly constant axes Pearson is typed undefined, covariance is zero; with a singleton Pearson/sample covariance are null, population covariance is zero.
Empty or all-skipped inputs refuse; mismatched source lengths, more than 4096 source pairs and nonfinite present inputs always refuse.
Numerical failure for nonconstant data is not reclassified as zero variance; finite Pearson arithmetic still lacks an unconditional rounding guarantee.
Type-7 binary64 exact knots bypass an otherwise overflowing adjacent subtraction, but nontrivial interpolation can still refuse.
Decision/MCDM consumption is documented by neutral public DTO conventions, not an implemented or verified external adapter.
No public NuGet feed, AURA skill, dw.discovery package, or BrokerReady implementation is admitted.
contribution.nextAction: After RS047 durable success, prepare M3-W02-C03-T1 for bounded distributions and deterministic seeded random sampling, preserving explicit mathematical/provider conventions.

achievements.achievement: Compile and observe a genuine RS047 reflection RED against the qualified preview.3 for missing typed Pearson status and paired nullable-input policy; retain the terminal marker.
